first_blade.title: A cutting edge
first_blade.text: {who} knapped the island's first stone blade.

first_axe_head.title: An axe head
first_axe_head.text: {who} knapped a stone into an axe head.

first_axe.title: The first axe
first_axe.text: {who} bound a stone head to a handle and made an axe.

first_digger.title: A digging tool
first_digger.text: {who} hafted the island's first digging tool.

first_prepared_clay.title: Workable clay
first_prepared_clay.text: {who} kneaded raw clay smooth and ready to shape.

first_fired_pot.title: Fired pottery
first_fired_pot.text: {who} watched clay turn to ceramic in the fire.

first_water_vessel.title: Water to carry
first_water_vessel.text: {who} filled a fired vessel at the pond.

first_porridge.title: Porridge
first_porridge.text: {who} cooked grain and water into porridge.

first_split.title: Split timber
first_split.text: {who} split a log along its grain.

tree_felled.title: The great tree falls
tree_felled.text: {who} felled the great tree. Its roots live on.

first_planting.title: The first planting
first_planting.text: {who} planted something in the island's soil.

harvest_tuber.title: Tuber harvest
harvest_tuber.text: {who} dug up the first skyroot tubers.

harvest_grain.title: Grain harvest
harvest_grain.text: {who} brought in the first island grain.

first_compost.title: Black gold
first_compost.text: {who} took the first finished compost from a heap.

first_railing.title: A railing
first_railing.text: {who} put up a railing above the abyss.

first_doorway.title: A doorway
first_doorway.text: {who} built a wall with a way through it.
